rows.en: －Monitor Room－＝＠２０９＿００１＊Narusawa＊...How's the work going?＝＠２０９＿００２＊Sakaki＊Fine.￥Every time I see it, I'm awed.
＠２０９＿０３＊Narusawa＊A new drive: the "Gate Glide."＝＠２０９＿０４It applies wormhole Gate theory,￥wraps the hull in a photon ring,￥and glides beyond physical law.
＠２０９＿０５＊Narusawa＊Its other name is the￥"Arrow of Light"...＝＠２０９＿０６It's the heart of Project Elan.￥It needs some majesty, or it￥wouldn't be convincing, right?

＠２０９＿０７＊Sakaki＊Video from an unmanned probe,￥arriving after a delay that￥makes your head spin...＝＠２０９＿０８And we're betting everything on￥that little bit of information.＝＠２０９＿０９＊Narusawa＊Atmosphere, molecular makeup...￥Nothing negative has turned up￥in the image analysis.＝＠２０９＿２１It's humanity's last-ditch￥effort to get a round-trip￥ticket to the planet Elan.＝＠２０９＿１０If I could, I'd go check it out￥with my own two hands, but...
＠２０９＿１１＊Sakaki＊Heh, you talk like you're going.￥Remember, our mission is...
＠２０９＿１２＊Narusawa＊I know...￥But at least it's a mission I'd￥be willing to trust them with.
＠２０９＿１３＊Sakaki＊Heh, true. If you're that taken￥with them, then surely...
＠２０９＿１４＊Sakaki＊So, who is it?￥Who's caught your eye?

＊Sakaki＊...＝＠２０９＿１６...Hey.＝＠２０９＿１７＊Narusawa＊Hm...?＝＠２０９＿１８＊Sakaki＊Can we really...￥pull this off...?＝＠２０９＿１９＊Narusawa＊...Yeah.￥We can.＝＠２０９＿２０I'll make sure of it. I'll keep￥humanity's lifeline intact...
